name: Duke
subtitle: Zone offense: screen the top, read and react
goal: Screen the top of the zone to get 4-on-3 on one side. Read it, don't force it.
options: 1 reads: pull-up, 2 in the corner, 5 in the short corner, then 4 on the roll. Nothing? Reverse to 3.

steps.note: 4 comes up and screens the defender on the ball. Hold the screen still and let 1 set it up.
1 dribbles off the screen. That pushes 2 to the corner and pulls 3 to the top. 5 cuts right away across the lane to the short corner. 4 holds the screen for a two-count.
After the two-count, 4 rolls to the elbow. Now it is 4-on-3. 1 does not drive all the way in: pull-up, 2 in the corner, 5 in the short corner, or 4 on the roll.
Nothing there? Reverse the ball to 3 and run it again on the other side.
